title: Luxuriously Optimized 2.0
description: This modpack is to give you an optifine experience but better. It has great shaders, resource packs, data packs, and performance mods.
body: This modpack mostly shows you an improved optifine experience but better. It has useful resource packs like continuity and more. There are great datapacks to play an improved version of minecraft, beautiful shaders and performance mods to get a great experience with shaders even on low-end pcs.
